measurement_definitions.T0: Parent sets now+1second after all400 connections are ready. Setup connections are not400 concurrent HTTP requests.

measurement_definitions.logical_concurrency: 400 user slots, each issuing sequential requests; logical users are distinct from active requests.
measurement_definitions.client_observed_transport_proxy: [writer.write return,terminal): enqueued outstanding. drain return is flow-control progress, not physical wire transmission proof.
measurement_definitions.stub_arrival_concurrency: [complete request header read,response drain return): arrived resident requests; fixed hold and local buffering are included.
measurement_definitions.completion: Complete fixed status/headers/body validated by client. Completion events/counts are separate from resident concurrency.
measurement_definitions.request_elapsed: terminal validation/failure/cancellation time minus immediately-before-write begin; includes client scheduling/buffering, local network stack, stub hold and response validation. No200ms/artificial/client overhead subtraction.
measurement_definitions.server_processing: Stub resident wall and own-process CPU can be observed; neither is SUT application CPU/service time.
measurement_definitions.outcomes: One of success/failure/cancelled/not_started per planned id. Setup/child/log incompleteness invalidates the attempt; it is not silently counted as zero failure.
measurement_definitions.drain: Bounded client drain after stop issuing; stub listener closes after clients exit, then bounded2s handler drain/cancellation. No post-window response may manufacture a client success.
measurement_definitions.P95: Nearest-rank ceil(.95*N) on pooled raw successful elapsed, not averaged worker percentiles. Every non-success/incomplete outcome separately disqualifies calibration, preventing hidden failed tails.
measurement_definitions.throughput: successes*60/short observed seconds, labeled normalized short-window rate only. Not a measured full-minute or600s outcome.
measurement_definitions.resource_sampling: Each owned event loop samples only its own RUSAGE_SELF every100ms, with sampler CPU/wall duration and loop lag. Sampling/logging/parse costs remain included. No sampler-off run; residual perturbation remains unknown.
